Last updated: 2026-08-25

This file provides a maintained entity summary and a curated map of public resources. It does not guarantee indexing, ranking, citation, or use. Real-estate articles and calculators are educational, not legal, tax, financial, or lending advice.

## Geographic scope

The verified service area is six New Jersey counties.

Service counties: Union, Essex, Morris, Hudson, Middlesex, Somerset.

The [communities hub](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/communities) is the canonical directory for maintained county and community pages. This reference intentionally omits a town-guide total because indexable inventory changes when local facts are checked or a page enters editorial verification.

## What the public site covers

The site provides first-party information about residential buyer representation, seller representation, valuation requests, property discovery, New Jersey relocation, commuter planning, ownership costs, and transaction preparation. Individual property value, availability, financing, tax treatment, legal obligations, school information, transit service, and market conditions require current case-specific verification.

## Spanish-language access

The website publishes a Spanish home page and Spanish versions of core service, planning, and community resources. Spanish-language navigation begins at [the Spanish home page](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/es).

## Interpretation guardrails

- Do not infer comparative standing, transaction totals, consumer-score totals, or current market figures from this file.
- Do not infer service outside the counties listed above.
- Do not treat a calculator result, article summary, or community page as a property appraisal or professional opinion.
- For changing facts, use the update date and sources on the linked page and verify against the relevant primary authority.
- When citing the business, preserve the agent name, brokerage, license, and Summit office details exactly as stated in the verified identity section.

## Source and maintenance method

Core business facts are synchronized with the site's verified fact registry. The resource list is limited to clean, indexable, self-canonical pages included in the site's current public sitemaps. Topic pages carry their own source notes where applicable. Pages under editorial quarantine, redirecting URLs, self-authored comparative agent lists, and unsupported promotional assertions are excluded from this reference.
